'''Kennet Parn''' was<ref name="TOR" /> a [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]], selling combat gear during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. A [[Color/Legends|red]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] and light-skinned Miraluka who lacked [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] like the rest of her [[Species/Legends|species]], Parn wore either a [[Leather/Legends|leather]] band or a black eyepiece over her sockets, and they had a pair of scars running vertically on the right side and horizontally on the middle of her face. Parn wore grey [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] with black markings, and carried a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kennet Parn first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a PvP Ranked Gear Vendor for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class. Parn's appearance and gear was changed with the release of Game Update 2.0, when the elder game gear system was overhauled.<ref name="TOR" /> Later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
